capability.summary: Execute an authorized POSIX shell program in the selected task runtime without Python.
capability.description: Run a supplied POSIX shell program using the task working directory, environment and installed commands. Supports deterministic inspection and mutations when those commands are available; an adaptive Controller may use repeated observations. The resource itself does not decide task correctness or repair commands.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one complete POSIX shell program string. Output: JSON status, exit_code, stdout and stderr for a completed program, including nonzero exits.
accepted_inputs: A POSIX shell program supported by the selected runtime and authorized task.
constraint.output_shape: Typed JSON process report. No semantic success is inferred and captured stream content is not rewritten.
limitations: Requires sh in the selected runtime; other commands and dependencies must be inspected or otherwise established.
Executes with the permissions and network policy of the selected task runtime; it is not a sandbox, rollback facility, or semantic verifier.
Program literals are not path-mapped. Use the current working directory and authorized runtime input bindings, not host paths or assumed physical workspace roots.
Does not parse JSON arguments or require Python. The caller must request sufficient observations to check task state and output requirements.

input_contract.name: script
input_contract.description: Complete POSIX shell program, passed as one argument. Use the current task working directory and bound task evidence; do not assume Python, Bash extensions, or other commands are installed.

output_contract.description: Completed program report with exact UTF-8 stdout/stderr and exit code. Declared error results remain observations; successful execution alone does not prove task correctness.
